questions.q: On what date is the Day of Tarwiyah?
questions.explain: The Day of Tarwiyah is 8 Dhul-Hijjah, a day before Arafah.

questions.q: How did Prophet Ibrahim AS call his father, who kept the house of idols?
questions.explain: Ibrahim and Muhammad did not answer with curses; they stated the truth without hatred.

questions.q: What does Al-Hujurat 49:13 stress about people?
options: No people is superior to another; the noblest is the most God-fearing
questions.explain: The brotherhood of humankind was stressed in the sermon at Arafah.

questions.q: What does the ustaz advise about fasting on Arafah?
options: A very good sunnah, do not make obligatory what is not
questions.explain: Fasting on Arafah is for those not performing Hajj.

questions.q: What is meant by sacrificing until it feels heavy?
options: Giving something you love until you feel the sacrifice
Giving what you do not want
questions.explain: Not just a little from the leftovers.

questions.q: Hajj and umrah should be made into social media content.
questions.explain: False. Worship is not content; focus must stay on worship.

questions.q: Ibrahim and Muhammad answered opponents with curses.
questions.explain: False. They kept asking forgiveness for their people.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The Prophet SAW calls out to Quraysh
Hundreds of thousands of companions camp outside Madinah
The Prophet SAW prays until sunset and drinks milk

questions.explain: The call to Quraysh, then the Hajj: the companions camped, prayed at Arafah and the sermon was given.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: 9 Dhul-Hijjah, the peak day of Hajj
The opening sermon recited by the Prophet SAW

questions.explain: Khutbat al-hajah is the opening sermon, fiqh is deep understanding, Arafah is 9 Dhul-Hijjah, and ajam means non-Arab.

questions.q: The main problem is not a lack of knowledge but a lack of what?
options: Courage to take the first step
questions.explain: Knowledge must be followed by action.
